messages:
ria: FYI deploy started for v2025.03.01 -> canary 10% eu-west. I'm seeing a small auth spike (~2.3% 401 on /v1/generate). Holding rollout, tagging this thread.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: v2025.03.01 -> canary 10% (eu-west). Traffic shifted. Hold requested: true. Pin applied to previous stable group for traffic split. (ops token: *******)

dan: Can you paste a sample request id or short log? Curious if this is client-side tokens or auth-service change.

mika: quick sample from gateway logs:
```
[2025-06-02T15:01:22Z] req=abcd1234 status=401 path=/v1/generate user=acme-corp client=redwood-frontend/2.1.0 auth_err="token expired"
[2025-06-02T15:02:10Z] req=abcd1289 status=401 path=/v1/generate user=acme-corp client=redwood-frontend/2.1.0 auth_err="invalid signature"
```

ashley: Noted. Release lead — would you prefer immediate rollback in eu-west to v2025.02.27 while we triage? I can update release notes and customer comms.

ria: I'm leaning rollback for eu-west only while we investigate. We don't want to risk more customer impact. @dan can you estimate fix time? @mika please confirm cluster health.

deploy-bot: Action requested: pin traffic for eu-west to v2025.02.27. Rollback requires explicit approval from release lead. Current canary frozen at 10%.

dan: I can attempt a quick patch (looks like auth header schema changed in the client lib). If it's a quick revert patch I can push within ~25m. If not, prefer rollback.

mika: quick k8s check:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n auth
auth-service-5f6d8  Running  0/1  3m
auth-service-5f6d9  CrashLoopBackOff  2/1  4m
```
There were a couple restarts around the canary window.

ashley: I'll prepare rollback notes and update the release page: https://internal.redwood/release/v2025.03.01. Drafting customer notify for affected EU customers.

ria: Decision: HOLD rollout at 10% for eu-west and pin traffic back to v2025.02.27. If dan's patch is ready in <30m we'll reevaluate and may resume. Otherwise perform eu-west rollback. Ops oncall ready to execute.

deploy-bot: Confirmed: hold applied. Canary frozen. Rollback pin queued for eu-west -> v2025.02.27 pending release lead approval. :white_check_mark:

dan: I'll post status in 20m. If I can't push a safe fix I'll sign off for rollback.

mika: ops ready for rollback. No DB schema changes detected.

ria: Thanks all — keeping thread open. If we escalate, we'll move to #incidents and loop in support. :thumbsup:
